summary: Operations leader who finds where work is stalling, makes it visible, and builds the process that keeps it moving. As an ION Solar area manager in 2021, Eric ran post-sale operations for the Las Vegas and Arizona markets and contributed to a 57% increase in PTO processing rate. Since then he has written construction SOPs and set up inventory, fleet, and quality controls for a Lehi home builder, cut return-to-resolution time about 50% at Lion Energy, and owned software used by more than 2,000 seasonal reps at Aptive. He helped grow a Vivint installation-support team from 20 to more than 50 reps and still sells energy management today, leading a 70% attachment rate on Vivint's Smart Comfort program. He wants to bring that mix of KPIs, SOPs, and people development back to an ION department.

paragraphs: Getting a solar project from signed contract to permission to operate is mostly a handoff problem. I learned that in 2021 running post sale operations for ION's Las Vegas and Arizona markets, and it's why this opening in Orem caught my eye.

Projects back then stalled between departments, and nobody could easily see where. I tightened up our status tracking, found the bottlenecks, and got the right teams working on them together. Our PTO processing rate rose 57%. Since then I've written construction SOPs and set up inventory, fleet, and quality controls for a Lehi home builder. At Lion Energy I improved a return operation handling about 10,000 units a year, cutting resolution time roughly in half.

Leading people is the other half of this job. At Vivint I helped grow an installation support team from about 20 reps to more than 50, and later coordinated a four person analytics team that built the dashboards leadership used to manage installs. And I still sell energy management today, so I hear every week what customers expect after the sale. I'd like to sit down and walk through how I'd attack your department's bottlenecks in the first 90 days. When works for you?
